title: 第5章 凌家祖地第6章 凌家帝卫
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 青霄仙宫的事情告一段落后
虚空之中，一座晶壁辉煌的宫殿内
“宫主，难道我们真的要忍受这份耻辱吗？”
齐紫阳看着在冰棺中的彩儿，随后又看着青霜道
“是啊宫主，虽然我们青霄仙宫没落，但还不至于被一个十岁孩子如此侮辱，这口气我忍不了”
叶绝空也赞同齐紫阳的看法，往年的青霄仙宫是何等的存在，如今落败竟然被一个十岁孩子羞辱
“二位长老说的本宫也理解，但是以我们现在的实力贸然与凌家开战，无疑是以卵击石，此事需商讨而定”
青霜看着冰棺里的彩儿道，看着自己心爱的徒儿如今变成这幅模样内心深处又怎会甘心
"本宫绝不会让凌家小子成长起来，一定要彻底扼杀在摇篮之中”
青霄仙宫众长老眼里闪过无穷的杀意道
随后整座宫殿也消失在虚空之中
凌家
神殿内
“如果按照这个时间来算的话，现在的叶辰应该不过是炼气期的蝼蚁吧，而前世我所知道的叶辰是在三年后迅速崛起，不用五年便成为下界的一代人皇，羽化飞升来到三千大世界”
而后叶辰升到三千大世界十年后，鬼界与魔界联手攻打人界，而这场大战我凌家为第一目标，最后凌家三十六祖中，仅剩下三十六老祖活着，其余老祖都与鬼界魔界的鬼圣，魔圣，甚至准仙帝强者同归于尽，而三十六祖根基也受到极大的伤，鬼帝魔帝也受到极大的道伤，从此凌家元气大伤，实力更是十不存一
这也是叶辰和其他势力有机会灭掉凌家的原因，而后叶辰突破准仙帝，以鬼界魔界两界为垫脚石，灭杀了鬼帝与魔帝，一统人鬼魔三界
所以首要做的是先除掉叶辰和前世杀我凌家的势力，一个都不能留，甚至一只蚂蚁都要杀
凌浩盘坐在床上道，身上的灵压不断的向外扩散
“现在当务之急是提高实力，然后去下界将有关叶辰的势力全部灭杀在摇篮里”
凌浩眼里闪过浓浓的血光
虽然以凌浩的地位，要想灭一个下界是一句话的事情，但是凌浩并不想怎么做，而是让叶辰体验一下什么叫绝望，还有前世那些落井下石的势力
“来人”
凌浩站起身来喊道
“神子，有何吩咐？”
一位金甲侍卫单膝下跪在门外道
“备车，我要去祖地”
凌家祖地是凌家历代先祖所在之地，凌家在能成为三千大世界的霸主，祖地是中心力量，现今凌家祖地有三十六祖还活在世上，其中三十个是仙圣巅峰的强者，还有五个是准仙帝强者，而如今的三十六祖，乃是三千大世界中十大仙帝之一
其他九帝乃是各界仙帝
鬼界鬼帝
content_en:
After the incident in Qingxiao Immortal Palace came to an end,
In the void, inside a palace with brilliant crystal walls
"Palace Master, do we really have to endure this shame?"
Qi Ziyang looked at Cai'er in the ice coffin, then looked at Qingshuang and said
"Yes, Palace Master, although our Qingxiao Immortal Palace is in decline, we are still not so insulted by a ten-year-old child. I can't bear this tone."
Ye Juekong also agreed with Qi Ziyang's view. What a great existence the Qingxiao Immortal Palace was in the past, but now it was defeated and humiliated by a ten-year-old child.
"I understand what the two elders said, but with our current strength, rashly starting a war with the Ling family will undoubtedly be an egg against a stone. This matter needs to be discussed and decided."
Qingshuang looked at Cai'er in the ice coffin and said, "How can I be willing to see my beloved disciple become like this now?"
"I will never let the Ling family's boy grow up. He must be completely strangled in the cradle."
"Yes"
The eyes of the elders of Qingxiao Immortal Palace flashed with endless killing intent.
Then the entire palace disappeared into the void
Ling family
inside the temple
"If calculated according to this time, the current Ye Chen should be just an ant in the Qi refining period. However, the Ye Chen I knew in the previous life rose rapidly after three years. In less than five years, he became the emperor of the lower world, and ascended to the Three Thousand Worlds."
Then ten years after Ye Chen ascended to the Three Thousand Worlds, the ghost world and the demon world joined forces to attack the human world. In this battle, my Ling family was the first target. In the end, among the thirty-six ancestors of the Ling family, only thirty-six ancestors were left alive. The rest of the ancestors died together with the ghost saints, demon saints, and even the powerful quasi-immortal emperors in the ghost world. The foundation of the thirty-six ancestors was also greatly injured, and the ghost emperor and devil emperor were also greatly injured. From then on, the Ling family's vitality was severely damaged, and their strength was even less than ten.
This is also the reason why Ye Chen and other forces had the opportunity to destroy the Ling family. Then Ye Chen broke through the Quasi-Immortal Emperor and used the ghost world and the devil world as a stepping stone to kill the ghost emperor and the devil emperor, and unified the three realms of humans, ghosts and demons.
So the first thing to do is to get rid of Ye Chen and the forces that killed my Ling family in the previous life. No one can be left, not even an ant must be killed.
Ling Hao sat cross-legged on the bed and said, the spiritual pressure on his body continued to spread outwards
"The top priority now is to improve our strength, and then go to the lower realm to kill all the forces related to Ye Chen in the cradle."
Ling Hao's eyes flashed with blood
Although with Ling Hao's status, it was only a matter of words to destroy a lower realm, but Ling Hao didn't want to do anything, but let Ye Chen experience what despair is, and the forces that made trouble in the previous life.
"Comer"
Ling Hao stood up and shouted
"Son of God, what are your orders?"
A guard in golden armor knelt on one knee outside the door and said
"Prepare the car, I want to go to the ancestral land"
"Yes"
The Ling family's ancestral land is the place where the ancestors of the Ling family have lived. If the Ling family can become the overlord of the Three Thousand Worlds, the ancestral land is the central force. Today, there are thirty-six ancestors in the Ling family's ancestral land still alive in the world. Thirty of them are strong men at the peak of Immortal Saints, and five are quasi-immortal emperors. Today's thirty-six ancestors are one of the top ten Immortal Emperors in the Three Thousand Worlds.
The other nine emperors are immortal emperors from all walks of life
Ghost World Ghost Emperor
